europe_now.title: EU Border Policy Plan
europe_now.summary: A group of 16 EU states has confirmed support for a new plan allowing countries to close borders and freeze asylum applications. The proposal highlights shifting migration policies within the bloc as leaders debate regional security measures.

sources.headline: 16 EU states confirmed on board for plan to let countries close borders and freeze asylum

europe_now.title: Franco-German Policy Agreement
europe_now.summary: France and Germany have reached a bargain concerning automotive emissions regulations and regional industrial strategy. The agreement addresses key economic priorities for both nations within the European framework.

sources.headline: France, Germany strike bargain on Made in Europe, car emissions

top_stories.title: European Union Summit and Budget Negotiations
top_stories.summary: European leaders gathered in Brussels to address ongoing budget divisions and financial support for Ukraine. Discussions during the summit also focused more broadly on the bloc's security and energy challenges.

sources.headline: EU leaders face budget divisions, discuss Ukraine at Brussels summit

top_stories.title: Air Traffic Disruptions in Italy
top_stories.summary: Italy reduced its air traffic capacity by half due to a data transmission issue affecting operations. The technical disruption impacted national infrastructure and air travel management.
